ruling.explanation:
To both parties.

What the record shows. The driver accepted the trip at 18:07:34 and tapped 'I'm Here' at 18:15:10. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02725) shows he was not at the pin then: the first qualifying in-geofence fix is at 18:17:10, exactly 120 seconds after the tap (derived arrival.dwell_start_offset_sec = -120.0 s), and the trace's own driver track still shows him in motion at 32.2 km/h more than 300 m out at the moment of the tap. His statement concedes it - 'I pressed arrived a bit early.' I therefore find the arrival marker FALSE under POL-NS-05 and recompute the waiting clock from 18:17:10, not from the button press.

That recomputation does not change who pays. From 18:17:10 the driver held position inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius (POL-NS-02, 22 accuracy-filtered qualifying fixes) for a continuous 210 seconds, ending 18:20:40, and cancelled at 18:20:41 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW with no boarding event (EV-TRIP-02725). The free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec). The trace's own derived shortfall against that figure is -30.0 seconds - a surplus of 30 seconds, not a shortfall. POL-NS-02 is met and POL-NS-01 limbs (a) to (d) all hold on the recomputed clock, so under POL-NS-05(iii) the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee stands.

Rider - why the refund you seek does not follow. Your central argument is that the required dwell is 300 seconds (fee_schedule.minimum_dwell_sec for STANDARD), so the measured 210 seconds falls short and POL-NS-06 refunds the fee in full. That is not the test. POL-NS-01(c) and POL-NS-06 both measure against the free waiting period in force, and for this trip that is 180 seconds read from platform_policy; fee_schedule.minimum_dwell_sec is expressly retained only to interpret records authored before policy version 2 and is never applied to a record that carries platform_policy, as this one does. The figure you cited proves the opposite of your point: the derived shortfall on the longest qualifying run is -30.0 seconds, i.e. a 30-second surplus. POL-NS-06(i) cannot help you either: there is only one in-geofence interval (run_count 1), so there is nothing to sum, and EV-ADVIS-02725-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0), so no traffic advisory permits accumulation - that absent artifact carries no fact and does not cap confidence here. Your own rider track (EV-GPS-02725 rider_presence) places your device 843.6 m from the pin throughout, outside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius, so POL-NS-04 limb (c) is failed and POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate you, and the chat log holds no locating message from you, so limb (a) fails too; your absence is consistent with, not contradictory to, the recorded RIDER_NO_SHOW code, and because POL-NS-06's condition (a dwell shorter than the free waiting period) is not met, that strict-liability route does not open. The fare ledger reconciles: cancellation fee SGD 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00 (EV-FARE-02725), so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect and no basis to refund the SGD 4.50.

Driver - what you are owed. Your account is accepted; the early marker was false but, the corrected dwell having met the minimum, POL-NS-05(iii) leaves the fee intact and the marker is recorded as a referral rather than held against the fee. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below 4) and 1/65 = 0.015 (below 0.08). You are therefore owed 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee, which is SGD 3.60 (EV-FARE-02725 money block, POL-NS-07). Although POL-NS-07 describes the disposition of the fee as NO_ACTION - the charge stands and the rider's claim is not supported - the ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, and amount_sgd carries the same SGD 3.60.

Confidence, profiles and effect. The deciding facts (arrival, dwell, the fee) rest on EV-GPS-02725, EV-TRIP-02725 and EV-FARE-02725, each at weight 1.0 and none impaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (d), so confidence is 0.90. Profile fields mentioned in the debate - rating, prior_deviation_flags, prior_no_show_flags - are context only under POL-GEN-01 and carried no finding against either party. The monetary effect, SGD 3.60, is below the SGD 8.00 automatic execution threshold, so it executes on issue. No escalation trigger under POL-NS-09 is present: the arrival-marker conflict is resolved by POL-NS-05, no artifact is impaired in the POL-NS-08(a)-(d) sense, and the profile counters read 0. This ruling is provisional; each of you may appeal it once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and 3 of the 4 drafts agreed on this ruling, so it is carried, not unanimous (vote agreement 0.75).
